claims.claim: في تجربة صغيرة، اتبع عشرة أشخاص حمية لأسبوعين مرتين: مرة بفرصة نوم ثماني ساعات ونصف، ومرة خمس ساعات ونصف.
claims.source_title: Insufficient sleep undermines dietary efforts to reduce adiposity
claims.authors: Nedeltcheva AV, Kilkus JM, Imperial J, Schoeller DA, Penev PD
claims.study_type: Randomized two-period crossover trial (sleep laboratory, University of Chicago)
claims.population: Overweight, sedentary, non-smoking adults aged 35-49 (mean age 41, mean BMI 27.4); 3 women, 7 men
claims.main_finding: Each participant did two 14-day periods of moderate calorie restriction (90% of resting metabolic rate) with 8.5 h or 5.5 h time in bed, in random order, at least 3 months apart (measured sleep 7h25 vs 5h14).
claims.limitations: Very small (n=10) and short (14 days per condition); fat-free mass loss includes water and other lean tissue, not only muscle; laboratory setting; a single study.

claims.source_title: Insufficient sleep undermines dietary efforts to reduce adiposity
claims.authors: Nedeltcheva AV, Kilkus JM, Imperial J, Schoeller DA, Penev PD
claims.study_type: Randomized two-period crossover trial (sleep laboratory, University of Chicago)
claims.population: Overweight, sedentary, non-smoking adults aged 35-49 (mean age 41, mean BMI 27.4); 3 women, 7 men
claims.main_finding: Sleep curtailment decreased fat loss by 55% (1.4 vs 0.6 kg, P=0.043) and increased loss of fat-free body mass by 60% (1.5 vs 2.4 kg, P=0.002); also increased hunger and lower fat oxidation (higher RQ).
claims.limitations: Very small (n=10) and short (14 days per condition); fat-free mass loss includes water and other lean tissue, not only muscle; laboratory setting; a single study.
